description: State Highway Network Lines is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Caltrans. StateHighways are state highways based upon the Caltrans Linear Referencing System. Each record in this layer represents a highway segment where the county, route, postmile prefix, and postmile suffix are the same. Each segment has a begin and end postmile. This geometry is based upon the extraction from TSN on 8 June 2025. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher Caltrans. Its tags are CAOpenData, CalSTA, California Department of Transportation, California State Transportation Agency, Caltrans. It offers 7 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
